do: Block the wheels that stay on the ground
Front: jack at the centre of the crossmember
caution: Use only the specified jacking positions (p.G-2).

do: Front: set a safety stand under each side of the body frame and lower onto them
caution: The car is supported on safety stands, not on the jack (p.G-2).

do: Rear: jack at the differential
Rear: set a safety stand under each side of the body frame and lower onto them
Clear the engine bay of tools and people before starting the engine
Release the parking brake, put the selector in neutral and set the key to ACC
caution: Brake assist does not work with the engine off.

do: Tow with the rear wheels off the ground: raised, or on dollies
how: SP-1542. The rear wheels are the drive wheels.
caution: Never tow backward with the drive wheels on the ground.

do: If all four wheels must stay on the ground, tow forward only, slowly and for a short distance
how: The 1985 manual's limit is SP-1543 (another gearbox); no figure for this car's 3N71B is in the record, so keep the rear wheels up whenever it can be done.

do: On a hook, pull straight away from it and take up the slack slowly
caution: The rear hook is for emergency recovery only.

do: Warm the engine if it is cold
Take off the oil filler cap and drain the oil
how: The cap off lets the oil drain easily.

do: Fit the new filter
how: SP-1546: oil the gasket, fully hand tight, then 1/8 turn more with a band-type wrench.

do: Fill with oil to the F mark on the dipstick
how: Grade SP-023, viscosity SP-775, capacity SP-144.

do: Start the engine, check for leaks, then recheck the level
how: Look at the filter joint and the drain plug washer; top up if needed.
expect: No leak at either; level at F.

do: Check each belt for cracks or other damage
Press each belt with the thumb and measure its deflection; adjust if it is out
how: About 10 kg (22 lb) of thumb pressure. Alternator belt SP-025; air pump belt SP-761; A/C belt SP-1001 (1985 figure).

do: Check each plug for burned or eroded electrodes, fouling or cracked porcelain
caution: Do not pull on the plug cables to remove them.

do: Measure the electrode gap; replace the plug if it is out
Refit with a little anti-seize or molybdenum thread lubricant on the first few threads
Check every cooling hose, heater hoses included, for cracks or wear; replace any that show it
Pressurise the system with a radiator cap tester and look for leaks
caution: Never above 1.05 kg/cm2 (SP-1547). Steam and hot water escape when the cap comes off a hot radiator.

do: Drain the coolant by removing the radiator drain plug
caution: A hot engine scalds: let it cool first.

do: Fill with new coolant mixed for the coldest weather expected
how: Mixture SP-1548; capacity SP-050; antifreeze type SP-056.

do: Check the brake pedal for smooth operation
Check the pedal height; adjust by turning the stop switch, then tighten its lock nut
Check the pedal free play; adjust by turning the push rod, then tighten its lock nut
Check the fluid level is near the MAX line of the reservoir; top up to MAX
Pull the parking brake lever with 10 kg (22 lb) and count its stroke; adjust with the adjusting nut
Check the booster vacuum hoses, connectors and check valve for cracks, chafing and deterioration
Engine off, press the pedal several times; then hold it down and start the engine
expect: Pedal travel does not change with the engine off; the pedal sinks a little as the engine starts.

do: Make a simple dipstick from a wire
Put the dipstick into the oil filler hole of the steering gear
Pull it out and measure dimension L; add gear oil if the level is low
how: L is SP-1550; oil is SP-252.

do: Remove the hub and the inner and outer bearings
Clean the bearings in solvent and inspect them for damage
Repack with grease and fit a new oil seal
how: SP-1552 names the grease and the five places it goes.

do: Look over the rear axle for oil leaks; find and repair the cause of any
Remove the filler plug and check the oil reaches the bottom edge of the hole
expect: Oil level at the bottom edge of the filler hole.

do: Pull each belt out to be sure it moves smoothly
Check the webbing for scratches, tears or wear and the metal fittings for bends
caution: Do not take the buckle or the retractor apart.

do: Check the retractors work
Check the anchor bolts are tight
Check the brake lines, hoses and connections
how: Properly attached and connected; no leaks, cracks, chafing, abrasion or deterioration.

do: Disc brakes: check caliper operation and leaks, pad wear, and the condition and thickness of the disc
Drum brakes: check wheel cylinder operation and leaks, lining wear or damage, and the inner surface and inner diameter of the drum
Check steering wheel free play, steering operation, looseness of the gear housing and any oil leaking from it
Check the steering linkage, tie rod ends and arms
how: No excessive play at the tie rod ends, no damaged dust boots, no looseness or grease leaking at the tie rod ends.

do: Check the front suspension ball joints for damage, looseness and grease leakage
Tighten the seat mounting bolts and retighten any loose front and rear suspension nuts and bolts to their torque
how: The torques are in the suspension rows of specs. Wheel nuts: interval wheel_nuts.

do: Check the exhaust heat shields and the exhaust itself
how: Clearance between insulator and body and between insulator and exhaust; pipes, hangers and connections for severe corrosion, leaks or damage.

do: Set the parking brake and block the wheels
Turn off all accessories and remove the fuel filler cap
Warm the engine to normal operating temperature
Disconnect the tube at the idle compensator in the air cleaner and plug its end
Check the dash pot rod and the A/C throttle opener do not hold the throttle lever off the idle stop
Read the idle speed; set it with the throttle adjust screw if it is out
Warm the engine to normal operating temperature
Connect a tachometer
Disconnect the connector with the BY and GB wires
how: The figure on the page shows which one; the figure was not read.

do: Put a voltmeter on each terminal, GY and LgY: negative probe on the terminal, positive probe on battery positive
Start the engine, drop it quickly from 3000 rpm and watch both meters
expect: Current flows to both terminals at the same moment, at 1100 +/-50 rpm.

do: If they do not switch together, take the cap off the throttle sensor adjusting screw and turn it
how: It sets when voltmeter A (LgY) switches: screw in is earlier, screw out is later.

do: Refit the cap on the adjusting screw
Spray cleaner on the choke linkage to remove dirt and grease
Spray cleaner on both ends of the choke shaft while moving the choke valve slowly by hand
Dry the sprayed areas with compressed air
Apply spray lubricant and work the choke lever several times
Turn the ignition on
expect: The oil level warning light comes on.

do: Start the engine
At idle, disconnect the connector from the oil level sensor and ground the terminal
expect: The warning light comes on and the chime sounds.

do: Remove the sensor and check the oil holes of its oil chamber are clear; clean them with solvent if not
Put an ohmmeter on the sensor and move the float up and down; replace the sensor if it reads otherwise
expect: Float up: no continuity. Float down: continuity.

do: Turn the ignition on
expect: The coolant level warning light comes on.

do: Start the engine
At idle, disconnect the connector from the level sensor
expect: The warning light comes on and the chime sounds.

do: Remove the radiator cap to release the pressure, then take the sensor out of the radiator and plug the hole
caution: Steam and hot water escape from a hot radiator.

do: Check the sensor for cracks or damage
Start the engine and ground the threaded part of the sensor; replace the sensor if the light stays off
expect: The coolant level warning light comes on.

do: Check the starting assist fluid level in the reservoir
Disconnect the connector from the magnet switch on the starter motor
Disconnect the connector from the oil thermo unit on the oil pan and ground the loose connector to the body
Hold the tank's air bleed button in and turn the key to START
expect: Starting assist fluid spouts from the nozzle.

do: Park on level ground and set the parking brake firmly
Idle the engine for about two minutes
Move the selector through every position and leave it in P
Read the dipstick
Add fluid through the filler tube if it is low
